categories.name: kernel
categories.evidence: Changes libbitcoinkernel's C API and C++ wrapper in `src/kernel/bitcoinkernel.{cpp,h}` and `src/kernel/bitcoinkernel_wrapper.h` to optimize witness stack retrieval and adjust handle ownership.
categories.rationale: Optimizes witness stack access in the kernel C API from quadratic to linear time. Since #36895, 'reading a whole witness stack through it is O(n^2)', which this resolves by caching spans in an allocated handle.
